profile.description: Patria Bank SA, a credit institution, provides banking and other financial services to individual, small and medium enterprises, agribusinesses, and corporate customers in Romania. The company operates through: Retail, SME and Corporate; Agro; and Micro-enterprises segment. The company offers saving, demand, term, collateral, current, and sight deposits; working capital and VAT financing credit line, investment loans, company development, SME loans, umbrella, general expense, bridge loans, medium term financing, bank guarantees, factoring, and letters of credit; and personal loans, home mortgage loans, refinancing investment loans, real estate mortgages, and overdrafts, as well as debit and credit cards. It offers deposit and current accounts, domestic and international payments, foreign exchange transactions, working capital loans, medium term lending, bank guarantees, and letters of credit. The company was formerly known as Nextebank SA and changed its name to Patria Bank SA in 2016. Patria Bank SA was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Bucharest, Romania. Patria Bank SA operates as a subsidiary of EEAF Financial Services B.V.
